mutations.name: serve drops the deprecation log at start
kills: logs reconciler.intervalMs as deprecated at start when the config still sets it, and is silent when it does not

mutations.name: serve logs the deprecation whether or not the config sets intervalMs
mutations.replace: for (const deprecated of reconcilerDeprecations({ enabled: false, fullEvery: 3, repos: [], intervalMs: 1 })) log.warn({}, deprecated);
kills: logs reconciler.intervalMs as deprecated at start when the config still sets it, and is silent when it does not
